candidates.name: Myocarditis
support_spans: Elevated inflammatory markers and serum creatinine
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with hemoptysis, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and dyspnea on exertion, along with elevated inflammatory markers, elevated serum troponin T, and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, suggests myocarditis.

candidates.name: Acute Interstitial Pneumonia
support_spans: Bronchoalveolar lavage: 3 consecutive samples with increasing bloody return, total red blood cell count of 9000/µL
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates and bloody bronchoalveolar lavage, are consistent with acute interstitial pneumonia.

candidates.name: Vaccine-Induced Myocarditis
support_spans: He had received the Johnson & Johnson COVID vaccination approximately 4 weeks before presentation.
candidates.why: The patient's recent COVID vaccination and subsequent development of myocarditis-like symptoms and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction suggest vaccine-induced myocarditis.
